article.title: 5 [Court to which petition shall be presented.
article.content:
195[Court to which petition shall be presented.

Section 19  ·  Jurisdiction and procedure  ·  page 12 of the Act
Every petition under this Act shall be presented to the district court within the local limits of whose ordinary original civil jurisdiction:—
(i) the marriage was solemnized, or
(ii) the respondent, at the time of the presentation of the petition, resides, or
(iii) the parties to the marriage last resided together, or
6[(iiia) in case the wife is the petitioner, where she is residing on the date of presentation of the petition, or]
(iv) the petitioner is residing at the time of the presentation of the petition, in a case where the respondent is at that time, residing outside the territories to which this Act extends, or has not been heard of as being alive for a period of seven years or more by those persons who would naturally have heard of him if he were alive.]
5 Subs. by Act 68 of 1976, s. 12, for s. 19 (w.e.f. 27-5-1976).
6 Ins. by Act 50 of 2003, s. 4 (w.e.f. 23-12-2003).
